response.rationale: Both forms denote a casual short-sleeved top, but the card overstates a national lexical contrast. Indonesian kaus is well supported; Malaysian baju-T is used, but Malaysian reference terminology also includes kemeja-T, and T-shirt remains common. The relation should be framed as a preference or variation, not an exclusive different-common-word contrast. No false-friend contrast is indicated.
